content.comment_body: Hello all! I am working with [product_name] Soft Comfort to develop programs for my [product_name] device. Everything runs well on my [product_name], but I'm unsure which software I need to control my [product_name] from my PC or a panel. Since I am new to this, any guidance would be appreciated.

If your requirements are basic, the integrated web server is useful. This server can mimic the display interface of your [product_name] or [product_name] TDE panel and offers virtual control keys. The TDE panel itself does not need to be physically present for this functionality.

For the TD screen of [product_name] with [article_no], you only need the same [product_name] Soft Comfort software used for programming your device. When setting up textblocks, you can designate whether the text is shown on your [product_name] screen or TD screen—or both. TDE screens are available for certain [article_no] versions. You can also connect dedicated HMI screens to some [product_name] modules, like those from the KTP series. Programming your device for use with these panels requires [product_name] Soft Comfort. Inputs, outputs, and markers are accessible for monitoring and switching directly through the HMI. For internal values, such as timers or counters, you need to set up Virtual Inputs and Outputs using VM mapping. More information on this can be found in the help menu of [product_name] Soft Comfort. To program actual HMI panels, additional software such as [product_name] WinCC within TIA portal from [company_name] is required. There are many panel options compatible with [product_name].

Thank you for your assistance. I’m uncertain if I’ve fully understood, as my English is not strong. I want to know how to use the ASi interface on my [product_name] [version_no] ([article_no]) and how to remotely control the [product_name] from my PC.

For [product_name] Series [version_no], there is no AS-i module available. The [product_name] [version_no] introduces new hardware and is not compatible with older modules starting from [version_no] up. Previous AS-i modules only work with hardware up to [version_no].

It will help if you describe your intended task. For basic functionality, a PC is not needed; you can use the local interface provided: a 6x12 display with navigation, ESC, and OK buttons ([version_no] model). With TDE, there's a larger display and additional function keys, plus the interface can be placed up to 100 meters away with UTP cable or connect via LAN. If LAN is available, you can operate from anywhere within its reach. For extended control, the built-in web server enables remote and even mobile access. Creating an interface menu on top of your application is important. Refer to sample applications included with [product_name] Soft Comfort to learn how to present data and accept input using navigation keys, function keys, or digital inputs.

Hello! Thanks again for your support. I still don't have a clear answer. What software should I use to control the [product_name] [version_no] remotely from my PC? Currently, I use [product_name] Soft Comfort to create programs, and they load onto the [product_name] without errors. However, I want to turn inputs or outputs on/off from my PC using installed software. I am just getting started, please help.

Directly forcing an input or output from [product_name] Soft Comfort is not possible. You can use the web server to control digital inputs if your project includes entries assigned to those inputs. For instance, if DI1 triggers something, you can add an F1 block to trigger the same in parallel. F1 blocks are on the TDE and can be activated remotely through the web server, letting you press TDE buttons using your PC.
Thank you for the help. Is there a tutorial with examples that can guide me on this?

Here’s a simple example program that demonstrates some web server possibilities. When using the web server, the TDE must be selected. Operations can be performed with the F-keys and navigation keys on the web server. For example, F1 and F2 keys navigate menus, and cursor buttons select submenus. F3 and F4 adjust setpoints.

Thanks again. I‘d appreciate a PDF tutorial that explains the web server configuration in detail. I couldn’t open the file you attached using [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no]. Thank you for your help.
You wrote your program for [product_name] [version_no]. This device features an integrated web server and can only be programmed using [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: The main topic focuses on a user wanting to remotely operate [product_name] [version_no] hardware from their PC using [product_name] Soft Comfort, aiming for direct control similar to programming capabilities. Other participants clarify that while [product_name] Soft Comfort is used for development and uploading programs, it doesn't allow direct manipulation of device inputs/outputs remotely; instead, certain functions can be accessed via the built-in web server if set up properly. The discussion highlights gaps in understanding around configuration for remote interaction and the transition from development to runtime operation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates being able to directly operate [product_name] [version_no] inputs and outputs from their PC with ease using available software, effectively integrating the development/testing and operational control process, and expects support for remote operation via HMI or AS-interface as part of standard device capabilities.
